II. שׁבב (Assyrian šabâbu , blaze , compare Syriac burn , ray, flesh (Lexicons, compare PS); Arabic is blaze up (cf Ba ES 50 ) but = שׁ ? (Another; etymology in Ber Dan 8:22 )).
